'''Sixela''' was a [[Blue giant/Legends|blue giant]] in the [[Sixela system/Legends|Sixela system]] which was located in the [[Thuris sector/Legends|Thuris sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. At least three [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] Sixela.<ref name="RF: Uprising">''[[Rebel Force: Uprising]]''</ref>

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], It was destroyed by [[Resonance torpedo|prototype weapons]] launched by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Rezi Soresh]], completely wiping out the star system.<ref name="RF: Uprising" />
